texts.preamble: In The Matter Of Suo Moto Public Interest ... vs The State Of Chhattisgarh on 12 September, 2025 1 Manpreet High Court Of Chhattisgarh At Bilaspur Kaur Digitally signed Wppil No. 48 of 2024 by Manpreet Kaur Date: 2025.09.12 18:22:26 +0530 In The Matter Of Suo Moto Public Interest Litigation versus The State of Chhattisgarh Order Sheet 12.09.2025 This is an office reference.
texts.facts: It is submitted that by way of an instant writ petition (PIL), this Hon'ble Court has taken Suo Moto Cognizance of the situation of outbreak of Diarrhea in the Kharod village of District- In The Matter Of Suo Moto Public Interest ... vs The State Of Chhattisgarh on 12 September, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/44992677/ 1 2 Janjgir-Champa (C.G.) due to which 23 incidents have occurred after consuming contaminated water from a local hand pump. 2. It is respectfully submitted that the matter was listed before this Hon'ble Court on 26/08/2025, and this Hon'ble Court has directed the Secretary, Health & Family Welfare Department, Government of Chhattisgarh, to file his personal affidavit indicating the present status of the outbreak of Diarrhea and the measures undertaken by the State to control and prevent further spread of the disease. This Hon'ble Court further directed to list the matter on 12/09/2025. 3. It is respectfully submitted that at the present remaining 28 patients are not showing any symptoms of Diarrhea. The copy of the letter dated 21/08/2025 is being filed and annexed herewith as Annexure A/2 for the kind reference of this Hon'ble Court. It is submitted that stool test of 5 patients have conducted and the report has been found negative and the bacterial motility is not seen. The copy of the stool test report of 5 patients is being filed and annexed herewith marked as Annexure 3 A/3. It is respectfully submitted that the answering respondents, of the Department of Health and Family Welfare, have taken steps to seal the polluted water resources on the basis of a door-to-door survey, and after chlorinization of the water, safe drinking water is also being provided, and health related education is also being imparted. For example, people are being told to drink only clean water or boiled water. Instructions have also been issued with respect to covering the food items, and to consume fresh food only. Health-related instructions have also been given with regard to compulsorily washing of their hands before eating food and after using the toilet. Further instructions have been given to maintain cleanliness near the home and not allow collection of water. It is further submitted that instructions have also been given for not answering nature's call in open area and to use the toilet within the house, and to maintain cleanliness. It is submitted that instructions have been issued to contact the nearest Health Center in case of vomiting and showing any symptoms of Diarrhea. 4. It is respectfully submitted that as on the date, no person has been detected positive as per the information of the respondent Health Department. Herein, it would be pertinent to mention here In The Matter Of Suo Moto Public Interest ... vs The State Of Chhattisgarh on 12 September, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/44992677/ 2 that earlier 13 cases of Diarrhea were found in the Block Akaltara, Primary Health Center Nariyara and on the basis of symptoms one stool sample was taken in order to confirm the presence of Cholera. However, the stool sample has been found negative for Cholera. It is further submitted that earlier in Primary Health Center Amora, Block Navagarh, 16 cases of Diarrhea were found, and on the basis of symptoms, two stool samples were taken in order to confirm the presence of Cholera, and both the Stool samples have been found negative. It is submitted that earlier in the Community Health Center, Kharod, Block Pamgarh, 49 cases of diarrhea were found, and on the basis of symptoms two stool samples were taken in order to confirm the presence of cholera. However, both the stool samples were found to be negative. Thus, the 78 patients were not showing any symptoms of Diarrhea as on the last date of hearing dated 23/07/2025. Copy of the relevant chart for the month of July is being filed and annexed herewith as Annexure A/4. 5. It is respectfully submitted that the State Government is taking the following measures for the prevention and control of acute diarrhoeal disease. "1 State-level guidelines and instructions have been issued for prevention, control, and management of seasonal infectious diseases. (Annexure-1). The copy of the guidelines dated 07/07/2025 is being filed herewith marked as Annexure A/5 for the kind reference of this Hon'ble Court. 2. Epidemic-prone and inaccessible villages have been identified, and advance arrangements have been made to ensure uninterrupted medicine supplies in such areas during the rainy season. 3. Rapid Response Teams (RRTs) have been constituted at both district and block levels for immediate response. 4 Disinfection and chlorination of drinking water sources is being carried out across all districts. 5. Testing facilities for epidemic-related diseases have been ensured in all medical colleges and district hospitals. 6. Awareness campaigns on epidemic prevention and control are being conducted at the district level. 7. A letter was issued to the Chief Medical & Health Officer, Janjgir- Champa District, in compliance with the Hon'ble High Court's Order dated 23.07.2025 in WPPIL, by the Director of Health Services on 20.08.2025. (Annexure-2) . The copy of letter dated 20/08/2025 is being filed herewith as Annexure A/6 for the kind reference of this Hon'ble Court. In The Matter Of Suo Moto Public Interest ... vs The State Of Chhattisgarh on 12 September, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/44992677/ 3 8. Weekly feedback reports are being submitted to the State for monitoring of outbreaks 9. A circular was issued to all Chief Medical & Health Officers on 25.06.2025 regarding preparedness for epidemic control in outbreak-affected areas. (Annexure-3). The circular dated 25/06/2025 is being filed herewith as Annexure A/7 for the kind reference of this Hon'ble Court. 10. Acute Diarrhoeal Disease (ADD) cases and outbreaks are being regularly identified and reported under IDSP-IHIP, and prompt remedial measures are being undertaken from time to time. 6. It is respectfully submitted, herein, it would be pertinent to mention that earlier, the Health Department of District Janjgir-Champa (C.G.) had set up a camp in the affected area. However, at present, no positive cases of Diarrhea have been found, and therefore, there is no necessity of setting up the camp. Therefore, the camps have been withdrawn. It is submitted that at present, as per the information received by the answering respondent, the situation is in control and there is no evidence of spread of diarrhea in any of the affected areas.
texts.arguments: Hence, it is submitted that the direction issued by this Hon'ble Court has been substantially complied with. 7. It is submitted that the answering respondents are under a duty to take necessary steps to control any situation affecting the health of the citizens and the common public whenever any such situation arises.
texts.petitioner_arguments: Hence, it is submitted that the direction issued by this Hon'ble Court has been substantially complied with. 7. It is submitted that the answering respondents are under a duty to take necessary steps to control any situation affecting the health of the citizens and the common public whenever any such situation arises.
